notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch + HTML/JSON parsing) was sufficient; site is server-rendered with embedded category JSON (breadcrumb, categoryId/categoryName, productCount, pager) in each category page's HTML, so no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt (https://www.manufactum.com/robots.txt) checked first: no Claude-specific disallow, only unrelated paths blocked (login, optin, newsletter, sell/recommendations) - proceeded. Discovery: fetched homepage for top-level nav (17 items: NEW, Gifts, Men, Women, Children, Garden, Kitchen, Home & Living, Household, Office Supplies, Sports & Toys, Luggage & Leather Goods, Body Care, Groceries, SALE, Manufacturers, Journal - no dedicated Halloween/Diwali/Thanksgiving/New Year/Indian-festival items), then fetched sitemap_pages.xml (1063 URLs) and grepped for christmas/weihnacht/advent/halloween/diwali/ostern/easter/valentin/thanksgiving/new-year/silvester/black-friday/st-patrick/hanukkah/eid/holi/rakhi/navratri - found genuine hits only for Christmas, Easter, Valentine's Day, plus Mother's/Father's Day and generic Autumn/Spring decoration branches discovered via the 'Decoration' category page; zero hits for Halloween, Diwali, Thanksgiving, New Year, Black Friday, St Patrick's, Eid, or any Indian festival anywhere in the sitemap. Also walked the actual category pages directly: the 'Christmas' hub (/christmas-c202272/), the legacy 'Home & Living > Home Accessories > Decoration > Christmas Decorations' branch, the 'Gifts > By occasion' hub (/gifts-occasion-c202438/, which lists birthday/wedding/moving/school/birth gifts - none seasonal besides Christmas/Santa/Valentine/Mother's/Father's Day), and 'Gifts > Wrap gifts' (only Christmas cards, no other holiday cards). Discriminator used to separate genuine PLPs from marketing/landing pages: every real PLP on this site carries a 'productCount':(N) field in its embedded JSON and lacks the 'kuratorContentsTop' curated-content block; every excluded page below has no productCount field at all (structurally absent, not zero) and does carry kuratorContentsTop, confirming it is an editorial/thematic landing page, not a category with its own listing. Verified this discriminator against multiple known-real PLPs (Christmas lights: productCount(29), 29 distinct product links; Christmas candle holders: productCount(22), 22 distinct product links - exact match) before applying it. Excluded as landing/marketing pages (no productCount, has kuratorContentsTop): Advent decoration (c199540), Christmas tree decorations dup (c199539 - a curated page distinct from the real PLP at c202277 which shares a near-identical name), The festive table (c200047), Magnetic advent calendar (c200031), Christmas gifts (c200701, under Gifts>By occasion), Valentine gifts (c200346, under Gifts>By occasion), Easter time (c199542, under Easter Decorations), Christmas baking dup (c199573, under Kitchen>Baking&Pastry - a curated recipe/product feature distinct from the real PLP Christmas baking at c202299), Christmas menu (c202491, under Journal>Recipes - a recipe/editorial article). Also excluded Herrnhuter Sterne (c200942) - a manufacturer/brand page under /manufacturers-c199727/, not a holiday category, even though the brand is Christmas-associated. 'Christmas' (c202272) itself has no productCount and no pager - recorded as a name-only grouping row (is_group true) per the shared parent/child rule, since it is a pure navigational container with real PLP children beneath it. 'Tree decorations' (c202277, qty 106), 'Christmas lights' (c202296, qty 29) and 'Christmas Decorations' (c189719, qty 193) each have their OWN productCount+pager (i.e. they are themselves real product listings, not pure labels) in addition to having narrower child categories beneath them (Balls/Pendants under Tree decorations; Stars under Christmas lights; candle holders/wreaths/candles/advent wreaths/advent calendars under Christmas Decorations) - kept as normal (non-group) rows with their own qty/link since each is independently a genuine PLP, and their children are additional genuine PLPs, not artifacts of the same listing (child counts are neither identical to nor simple subsets equal to the parent total, e.g. Balls 44 + Pendants 72 = 116 vs Tree decorations own total 106, confirming overlapping-but-distinct listings rather than an exact duplicate). Included Autumn decoration (c202630, qty 9) and Spring decoration (c202631, qty 68) as genuine seasonal-period categories (sibling branches to Christmas/Easter Decorations under the same 'Decoration' parent, each with its own productCount) per the ruleset's explicit allowance for Autumn/Spring/Summer/Winter as legitimate seasonal categories when they are real PLPs on the site's own taxonomy; no corresponding Summer/Winter decoration branch exists on this site. Included Santa Claus gifts (c202453, qty 175) and Secret Santa gifts (c202317, qty 70) as Christmas-associated PLPs under Gifts>By occasion (both carry productCount and, for Santa Claus gifts, an explicit pager). Included Father's Day (c199840, qty 55) and Mother's Day (c199841, qty 49) as genuine seasonal/occasion categories per the ruleset's explicit vocabulary, both real PLPs with productCount. No duplicate-listing overlaps found requiring a dedup note (each row's URL/count pair is distinct). Site-internal search endpoint could not be located from the rendered homepage markup (no discoverable search action URL to hit directly over HTTP), so absence of Halloween/Diwali/Thanksgiving/New Year/Indian-festival categories rests on: full top nav, the Christmas hub page, the Decoration parent category, the Gifts>By-occasion hub, the Gifts>Wrap-gifts branch, and an exhaustive keyword grep of the complete 1063-URL sitemap_pages.xml - not on search results alone.
